data.content_ref: inline:Covering conjecture: the four guarantees (determinism, polynomial cost, reinstatement-as-derived, committed-root validity) all follow from one property — the labeling operator is monotone and inflationary on the complete lattice of labelings. The admissible strengthening space is exactly the set of polynomial-time, monotone, idempotent operators on that lattice; reinstatement and root validity are theorems of monotonicity, not separate design constraints. If true, any proposed expansion should be rejected iff it violates monotonicity/idempotence, which gives a single testable criterion for the whole family.
